svg.title: A benchmark is a distribution, not a number
svg.desc: Left, a histogram of 500 per-iteration times with a fitted normal curve drawn over it; the bars are clearly right-skewed and do not follow the curve. Right, a normal QQ-plot whose points bend away from the straight reference line, the signature of a non-normal, heavy-tailed sample.

g.text: A benchmark is a distribution, not a number
memory-bound, 500 samples, Apple Silicon, Shapiro-Wilk p=2.7e-15
QQ-plot: a straight line would be normal
